# wqbench

This package contains the functions and tools to generate aquatic life
water quality benchmarks.

## Installation

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("bcgov/wqbench")
```

## Workflow

``` r
library(wqbench)
```

### Create Data Set for Shiny App

The
[`wqb_create_data_set()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_create_data_set.md)
function will download the US EPA ECOTOX¹ database, create a local
.sqlite database, add other data sources and filter conditions, clean
and process the data, classify the duration, standardize the effect and
output the completed data set needed for the shinywqbench app. The
function will create an RDS file of the data set as well. It takes a few
minutes to download and create the data set.

The default argument for:

- `file_path` will save the raw text files at
  `"~/Ecotoxicology/ecotox"`.
- `folder_path` will save the .sqlite database and RDS file is at
  `"~/Ecotoxicology/ecotox_db/"`.
- `version` will download the most recent version of the data set
  available on the website.

``` r
data_set <- wqb_create_data_set()
```

The data set can be read in after it has been created.

``` r
data_set <- readRDS("~/Ecotoxicology/ecotox_db/ecotox_ascii_09_12_2024.rds")
```

### Generate Benchmark

``` r
set.seed(101)
```

#### Deterministic Example

``` r
data <- wqb_filter_chemical(wqbenchdata::aquatic_data, "100016")
data <- wqb_benchmark_method(data)

data_agg <- wqb_aggregate(data)
data_agg <- wqb_af(data_agg)

ctv <- wqb_generate_ctv(data_agg)
ctv
```

``` R
## # A tibble: 1 × 3
##   ctv_est_mg.L ctv_lcl_mg.L ctv_ucl_mg.L
##          <dbl>        <dbl>        <dbl>
## 1          2.5           NA           NA
```

To calculate the benchmark for the chemical, divide the critical
toxicity value (ctv) by the assessment factors.

``` r
benchmark <- ctv / (data_agg$af_bc_species * data_agg$af_salmon * data_agg$af_planktonic * data_agg$af_variation)
benchmark
```

``` R
##   ctv_est_mg.L ctv_lcl_mg.L ctv_ucl_mg.L
## 1   0.04166667           NA           NA
```

*Deterministic* method only generates an estimate, the lcl and ucl
columns will always be blank .

``` r
# Plot data set
wqb_plot(data)
```

![](README_files/figure-gfm/unnamed-chunk-8-1.png)

``` r
# Plot the results
wqb_plot_det(data_agg)
```

![](README_files/figure-gfm/unnamed-chunk-9-1.png)

#### SSD Example

``` r
data <- wqb_filter_chemical(wqbenchdata::aquatic_data, "1071836")
data <- wqb_benchmark_method(data)

data_agg <- wqb_aggregate(data)
data_agg <- wqb_af(data_agg)

ctv <- wqb_generate_ctv(data_agg)
ctv
```

``` R
## # A tibble: 1 × 3
##   ctv_est_mg.L ctv_lcl_mg.L ctv_ucl_mg.L
##          <dbl>        <dbl>        <dbl>
## 1      0.00981      0.00105       0.0543
```

To calculate the benchmark for the chemical, divide the critical
toxicity value (ctv) by the assessment factors.

``` r
benchmark <- ctv / (data_agg$af_bc_species * data_agg$af_salmon * data_agg$af_planktonic * data_agg$af_variation)
benchmark
```

``` R
##   ctv_est_mg.L ctv_lcl_mg.L ctv_ucl_mg.L
## 1  0.009808029  0.001050889   0.05426475
```

*SSD* method can generate a lower and upper confidence interval.

``` r
# Plot data set
wqb_plot(data)
```

![](README_files/figure-gfm/unnamed-chunk-12-1.png)

``` r
# Plot the results
fit <- wqb_ssd_fit(data_agg)
wqb_plot_ssd(data_agg, fit)
```

![](README_files/figure-gfm/unnamed-chunk-13-1.png)

#### Summary Tables

``` r
wqb_summary_trophic_species(data_agg)
```

``` R
## # A tibble: 5 × 2
##   `Trophic Group` `Number of Species`
##   <fct>                         <int>
## 1 Algae                             6
## 2 Amphibian                         4
## 3 Fish                             11
## 4 Invertebrate                     12
## 5 Plant                             8
```

``` r
wqb_summary_trophic_groups(data_agg)
```

``` R
## # A tibble: 4 × 2
##   Consideration           Result                                                
##   <chr>                   <chr>                                                 
## 1 Trophic group(s)        Algae, Amphibian, Fish, Invertebrate, Plant           
## 2 Salmonid(s)             Oncorhynchus kisutch, Oncorhynchus mykiss, Oncorhynch…
## 3 Planktonic Invertebrate Artemia franciscana                                   
## 4 B.C. species            Cyprinus carpio, Lemna minor, Myriophyllum aquaticum,…
```

``` r
wqb_summary_af(data_agg)
```

``` R
## # A tibble: 3 × 3
##   Consideration                `Assessment Factor` Description                  
##   <chr>                                      <int> <chr>                        
## 1 Species variation factor                       1 Accounts for uncertainty due…
## 2 Ecological assessment factor                   1 Accounts for uncertainty whe…
## 3 B.C. species                                   1 Accounts for uncertainty of …
```

## Developer Instructions

See the [Developer
Instructions](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/articles/Developer-instructions.html)
on the package website for instructions on updating the reference data
for the database and updating the “Add Data” template

See the [README in the shinywqbench
repository](https://github.com/bcgov/shinywqbench?tab=readme-ov-file#shinywqbench)
for instructions for updating and deploying the [shiny
app](https://bcgov-env.shinyapps.io/shinywqbench/).

## Getting Help or Reporting an Issue

To report issues, bugs or enhancements, please file an
[issue](https://github.com/bcgov/wqbench/issues). Check out the
[support](https://github.com/bcgov/wqbench/blob/main/.github/SUPPORT.md)
for more info.

[Contributor Code of
Conduct](https://github.com/bcgov/wqbench/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). By
contributing to this project, you agree to abide by its terms.

## Reference

1.  Olker, J. H., Elonen, C. M., Pilli, A., Anderson, A., Kinziger, B.,
    Erickson, S., Skopinski, M., Pomplun, A., LaLone, C. A., Russom, C.
    L., & Hoff, D. (2022). The ECOTOXicology Knowledgebase: A Curated
    Database of Ecologically Relevant Toxicity Tests to Support
    Environmental Research and Risk Assessment. Environmental Toxicology
    and Chemistry, 41(6):1520-1539. <https://doi.org/10.1002/etc.5324>

# Package index

## All functions

- [`combine_bc_species()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/combine_bc_species.md)
  : Combine BC Species and DB Species
- [`combine_bc_wqg()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/combine_bc_wqg.md)
  : Combine BC Water Quality Guidelines with DB Chemicals
- [`combine_conc_conversions()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/combine_conc_conversions.md)
  : Combine Concentration Unit Conversation Values with DB Concentration
  Unit
- [`combine_concentration_endpoints()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/combine_concentration_endpoints.md)
  : Combine the Concentration Endpoints list to db endpoints
- [`combine_duration_conversions()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/combine_duration_conversions.md)
  : Combine Duration Unit Conversation Values and DB duration unit
- [`combine_lifestage()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/combine_lifestage.md)
  : Combine Life Stage Groups and db life stage
- [`combine_media()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/combine_media.md)
  : Combine Media Type Coding
- [`combine_trophic_group()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/combine_trophic_group.md)
  : Combine Trophic Groups and DB species
- [`join_data()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/join_data.md)
  : Join Data
- [`read_bc_species()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/read_bc_species.md)
  : Read in BC Species CSV
- [`read_bc_wqg()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/read_bc_wqg.md)
  : Read BC Water Quality Guidelines
- [`read_conc_conversions()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/read_conc_conversions.md)
  : Read Concentration Unit Conversation Values
- [`read_concentration_endpoints()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/read_concentration_endpoints.md)
  : Read the Concentration Endpoints
- [`read_duration_conversions()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/read_duration_conversions.md)
  : Read Duration Unit Conversation
- [`read_lifestage()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/read_lifestage.md)
  : Read Life Stage Groups
- [`read_trophic_group()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/read_trophic_group.md)
  : Read Trophic Groups and DB species
- [`template`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/template.md) :
  Template for Adding your own Data
- [`wqb_add_bc_species()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_add_bc_species.md)
  : Add BC Species
- [`wqb_add_bc_wqg()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_add_bc_wqg.md)
  : Add BC Water Quality Guidelines
- [`wqb_add_conc_conversions()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_add_conc_conversions.md)
  : Add Concentration Unit Conversation Values
- [`wqb_add_concentration_endpoints()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_add_concentration_endpoints.md)
  : Add the Concentration Endpoints
- [`wqb_add_duration_conversions()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_add_duration_conversions.md)
  : Add Duration Unit Conversation Values
- [`wqb_add_lifestage()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_add_lifestage.md)
  : Add Life Stage Groups
- [`wqb_add_media()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_add_media.md)
  : Add Media Type Coding of Salt or Fresh Water
- [`wqb_add_trophic_group()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_add_trophic_group.md)
  : Add Trophic Groups to Database
- [`wqb_af()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_af.md) :
  Determine the Assessment Factors
- [`wqb_af_bc_species()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_af_bc_species.md)
  : Determine the BC Species Assessment Factor
- [`wqb_af_ecological()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_af_ecological.md)
  : Determine the Ecological Assessment Factors
- [`wqb_af_variation()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_af_variation.md)
  : Determine the Species Variation Assessment Factor
- [`wqb_aggregate()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_aggregate.md)
  : Aggregate Data for each Species
- [`wqb_benchmark_method()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_benchmark_method.md)
  : Determine Benchmark Method
- [`wqb_check_add_data()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_check_add_data.md)
  : Check the Uploaded Data
- [`wqb_classify_duration()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_classify_duration.md)
  : Classify Duration
- [`wqb_clean_data()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_clean_data.md)
  : Compile Data
- [`wqb_create_data_set()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_create_data_set.md)
  : Create the Data Set for the App
- [`wqb_create_epa_ecotox()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_create_epa_ecotox.md)
  : Create the ECOTOX Database
- [`wqb_download_epa_ecotox()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_download_epa_ecotox.md)
  : Download ECOTOX Data Files
- [`wqb_filter_chemical()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_filter_chemical.md)
  : Filter to a Single Chemical
- [`wqb_generate_ctv()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_generate_ctv.md)
  : Generate Critical Toxicity Value
- [`wqb_join_data()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_join_data.md)
  : Join Data
- [`wqb_method_det()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_method_det.md)
  : Deterministic Method to Generate Critical Toxicity Value for the
  Chemical
- [`wqb_method_ssd()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_method_ssd.md)
  : SSD Method to Calculate Critical Toxicity Value for the Chemical
- [`wqb_plot()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_plot.md)
  : Plot Data
- [`wqb_plot_det()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_plot_det.md)
  : Plot the Deterministic Method Results
- [`wqb_plot_ssd()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_plot_ssd.md)
  : Plot Species Sensitivity Distribution
- [`wqb_ssd_fit()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_ssd_fit.md)
  : Fit BCANZ Distributions
- [`wqb_ssd_hc5()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_ssd_hc5.md)
  : Run SSD to get Hazard Concentrations
- [`wqb_standardize_effect()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_standardize_effect.md)
  : Standardize type of Effect
- [`wqb_summary_af()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_summary_af.md)
  : Summary Table of the Assessment Factor Values
- [`wqb_summary_trophic_groups()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_summary_trophic_groups.md)
  : Summary Table of Assessment Factors Information
- [`wqb_summary_trophic_species()`](https://bcgov.github.io/wqbench/reference/wqb_summary_trophic_species.md)
  : Summary Table of Number of Species per Trophic Group
